access-token.about-description: A personal access token (PAT) is a secret key that authenticates API requests as your account. Any app or script holding one — an MCP server, a CLI, a mobile client — can do everything you can do in Memos, until the token expires or you delete it. Send it as a Bearer credential in the Authorization header:
